component.name: Yunee
component.summary: A better Canvas client for GNOME

description.p: Yunee is a local, single-user client for Canvas LMS. It syncs your courses, assignments and their submission state, announcements, modules, files into a local SQLite database, so the app is fast and works offline. The network is touched only by the sync engine.

Nothing is hosted and nothing is shared: you sign in with your own Canvas personal access token, stored in the GNOME keyring, and your data stays on your machine. There is no account to create and no server in between.
First release: Canvas courses, assignments, announcements, modules, files, synced into local SQLite.
